understanding: The attached source resolves worker association with the leader commitment object. startStopReplication captures that object when constructing each worker, retains the worker for an existing server ID, and updates its peer record only when the address changes. Removal signals and deletes the worker without rebinding its commitment pointer. Leader cleanup clears leaderState references without clearing captured worker references or visibly joining workers. These observations establish ownership mechanisms, not termination completion, synchronization safety, or the semantics of removing and later reusing a server ID.

Shutdown uses a best-effort notification attempt.

surfaces.reason: The attached implementation establishes worker construction, commitment capture, same-ID address updates, and removal signaling. Mapping does not establish worker quiescence or same-ID reuse semantics.

delta.rationale: The diagnostic source is already attached, so no additional acquisition is needed. Separate worker reconciliation from leader entry and cleanup, record its consumption of the initialized accumulator, and replace resolved association unknowns with precise remaining lifetime and synchronization gaps. Existing Fact meanings, identities, validity contexts, and normative applicability are unchanged. Global Activity summaries and unrelated surfaces remain unchanged.

limitations: This refinement describes observed ownership and reference handling; it establishes neither a defect nor implementation correctness.
Worker termination completion, pipeline and heartbeat shutdown, same-ID reuse legality, configuration-update ordering, and synchronization safety remain unresolved.
No normative obligation, experiment, calibration result, or broader consequence is established.
